amendment_note: Exploratory, analysis-only test of an untuned geometry-aware Fourier correlator on already-audited text and matched-tabular artifacts, plus the frozen matched-entropy M6 locality controls. No learner or profile is recomputed.

joint_spectrum.definition: W[k,r] is squared Fourier coefficient mass whose support has categorical interaction degree k and geometric radius r
joint_spectrum.one_dimensional_radius: maximum causal lag in the support
joint_spectrum.interpretation: energy-weighted description/search cost of the active categorical coefficients; ordinary degree is recovered when support geometry is fixed

text.source: v1.6 corrected conditional spectra and v1.4 fresh contiguous-sequence learning curves
text.difficulty: median normalized curve area; higher is harder
text.natural_degree1_radius_sensitivity: because saved W1 aggregates the two additive coordinates, report both radius 1 and radius max(pair) endpoints

matched_tabular.source: v1.3 exact Formula-(19) spectra for nine real datasets in three exact row/feature-count bands
matched_tabular.primary_comparison: within-band Spearman against normalized curve area
matched_tabular.pooled_comparison: diagnostic only because feature count and alphabet geometry differ across bands

m6_locality_controls.source: eight q=32, identical-Bayes-floor families: F1 k=1,2,3,4,6,8 and copy lag 4,16
m6_locality_controls.difficulty: median final gap above the common Bayes floor at the fixed 3M-token budget; higher is harder
m6_locality_controls.purpose: test whether radius resolves same-degree copy tasks and degree-versus-span ordering

status: post-hoc exploratory; effect sizes and exact provenance are reported, not a confirmatory p-value claim
